title: selfdoc's section-reference match accepts any leading word of a heading, such as (querylog.md, The)
goal: names_heading no longer accepts any leading word run of a heading: (querylog.md, The) and (querylog.md, Store and Tests) are reported, while the short names the docs already use, such as (content-rules.md, Ledgers) for Ledgers and retrieval data, still pass (for example a prefix that ends at a heading separator or before a joining and); a planted case holds both (SP-ar52y6fk review of ST-mklj46kq)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import selfdoc as S;k=S.heading_keys(['## The research queue']);assert not S.names_heading('The',k),'a lone leading word names the heading'
